fixture.distribution: 5000 distinct grading/source chains in one dense day and site; two groups each, inventory-only evidence; synthetic TEST, no physical facts

cache: 5 fresh datasource/service sessions per endpoint (cold session/plan, connection setup excluded), 20 warm reads; PG shared/OS caches remain warm, NOT cold disk
